title: Whereas some samaṇas and brahmins, while enjoying food offered by the faithful, still live maintaining themselves by wrong livelihood such as predicting: There will be…
content: Whereas some samaṇas and brahmins, while enjoying food offered by the faithful, still live maintaining themselves by wrong livelihood such as predicting: There will be much rain, there will be drought, there will be a good harvest, there will be a bad harvest, there will be safety, there will be danger, there will be disease, there will be health; or they engage in occupations such as counting on fingers, accounting, adding large numbers, writing verses, worldly treatises — Samaṇa Gotama abstains from such wrong livelihood. — Bhikkhus, these are the praises of the Tathāgata by ordinary people.

title: - And, bhikkhus, when the mind is agitated, that is the time to cultivate the tranquility enlightenment factor, that is the time to cultivate the…
content: - And, bhikkhus, when the mind is agitated, that is the time to cultivate the tranquility enlightenment factor, that is the time to cultivate the concentration enlightenment factor, that is the time to cultivate the equanimity enlightenment factor. Why is that? Because the agitated mind is easy to calm down with these things. Just as, bhikkhus, a person who wants to extinguish a great fire, if he throws wet grass, wet cow-dung, and wet wood onto it, exposes it to wind and rain, and scatters dust on it, could he extinguish that great fire?" - "Yes, Venerable Sir." - "So too, bhikkhus, when the mind is agitated, that is the time to cultivate the tranquility enlightenment factor, that is the time to cultivate the concentration enlightenment factor, that is the time to cultivate the equanimity enlightenment factor. Why is that? Because the agitated mind is easy to calm down with these things. But regarding mindfulness, bhikkhus, I say that it is beneficial in every case.

title: Friends, the Tathāgata is pure in bodily conduct. There is no evil bodily deed that the Tathāgata needs to hide, thinking: 'Let no one know…
content: Friends, the Tathāgata is pure in bodily conduct. There is no evil bodily deed that the Tathāgata needs to hide, thinking: 'Let no one know this about me.' Friends, the Tathāgata is pure in verbal conduct. There is no evil verbal deed that the Tathāgata needs to hide, thinking: 'Let no one know this about me.' Friends, the Tathāgata is pure in mental conduct. There is no evil mental deed that the Tathāgata needs to hide, thinking: 'Let no one know this about me.'

title: And its former ignorant attachments are fully possessed and perfected. They are cut off, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, unable…
content: And its former ignorant attachments are fully possessed and perfected. They are cut off, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, unable to exist in the future, without the capacity to arise again. Therefore, a bhikkhu thus endowed is endowed with the supreme intellectual offering. For, bhikkhu, this is the supreme noble intellectual offering, namely the abandonment of all attachments.

title: Friends, here the Teacher lives in seclusion, but the disciples do not follow the practice of seclusion. The things that the Teacher teaches to be…
content: Friends, here the Teacher lives in seclusion, but the disciples do not follow the practice of seclusion. The things that the Teacher teaches to be abandoned, they do not abandon. And they live in abundance, lazy, leading the way to backsliding, neglecting the burden of seclusion.

title: Or when there is hatred internally, he understands: 'There is hatred in me'; or when there is no hatred internally, he understands: 'There is no…
content: Or when there is hatred internally, he understands: 'There is hatred in me'; or when there is no hatred internally, he understands: 'There is no hatred in me.' And he understands how unarisen hatred arises; and he understands how arisen hatred is abandoned; and he understands how abandoned hatred will not arise in the future.

title: Household wealth is abandoned, but hard to share in the goal of asceticism. One brings harm to oneself and brings distraction, Like a funeral torch…
content:
Household wealth is abandoned, but hard to share in the goal of asceticism.
One brings harm to oneself and brings distraction,
Like a funeral torch that goes to destruction.

Many who wear the yellow robe,
Of evil nature, unrestrained,
By their evil deeds, certainly go to hell.

Better to swallow a red-hot iron ball,
Blazing like a fire,
Than for an immoral, unrestrained person
To eat the country's almsfood.

title: Possessing forty qualities, as such is placed in heaven. What forty? He himself abstains from killing living beings, does not encourage others to kill, does…
content: Possessing forty qualities, as such is placed in heaven. What forty? He himself abstains from killing living beings, does not encourage others to kill, does not consent to killing, and does not praise killing; he himself abstains from taking what is not given, does not encourage others to take what is not given, does not consent to taking what is not given, and does not praise taking what is not given; he himself abstains from sexual misconduct, does not encourage others to engage in sexual misconduct, does not consent to sexual misconduct, and does not praise sexual misconduct; he himself does not speak falsely, does not encourage others to speak falsely, does not consent to false speech, and does not praise false speech; he himself abstains from divisive speech, does not encourage others to speak divisively, does not consent to divisive speech, and does not praise divisive speech; he himself does not speak harshly, does not encourage others to speak harshly, does not consent to harsh speech, and does not praise harsh speech; he himself abstains from idle chatter, does not encourage others to speak idly, does not consent to idle chatter, and does not praise idle chatter; he himself is not covetous, does not encourage others to be covetous, does not consent to covetousness, and does not praise covetousness; he himself has no ill-will, does not encourage others to have ill-will, does not consent to ill-will, and does not praise ill-will; he himself has right view, encourages others to have right view, consents to right view, and praises right view. Possessing these forty qualities, bhikkhus, as such is placed in heaven.

title: There are these four occasions, bhikkhus, that, if well developed and well conducted, lead progressively to the destruction of the taints. What four? Hearing the…
content: There are these four occasions, bhikkhus, that, if well developed and well conducted, lead progressively to the destruction of the taints. What four? Hearing the Dhamma at the right time, discussing the Dhamma at the right time, calming at the right time, contemplating at the right time. These four occasions, bhikkhus, if well developed and well conducted, lead progressively to the destruction of the taints.

title: This is impossible, bhikkhus, it cannot happen: that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of…
content: This is impossible, bhikkhus, it cannot happen: that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world. This is impossible. It is possible, bhikkhus, that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a plane of misery, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell. This is possible. This is impossible, bhikkhus, it cannot happen: that a person who has done evil verbal actions... evil mental actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world. This is impossible. It is possible, bhikkhus, that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a plane of misery, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell. This is possible.
